## **Testing (stories):**

* Slider on light background - one row - naviagtion top - has scrollbar 
* Slider on dark background - two rows - navigation bottom - has scrollbar 
* Slider on bright background - one row - navigation hidden - no scrollbar 
* Slider on light background - two rows - navigation bottom - has scrollbar - has action button

summary: Space-efficient horizontal slider for displaying subcategory nodes with configurable rows and navigation positioning.
features: One or two row slider options (two-row collapses to single on desktop)
Auto-hiding navigation when all nodes are visible on screen
Optional CTA button with variant selection
Support for promotional flags on category nodes
longDescription:
## Purpose

The InpageNavigationBasicSlider component provides a space-saving horizontal slider for displaying category nodes, ideal for interfaces where vertical space is limited. It is commonly used under listing page titles to display subcategories of the next navigation level.

## Use Cases

- Display subcategory navigation on product listing pages
- Show category previews in a compact horizontal format
- Provide one or two row layouts depending on content density needs
- Add promotional flags to highlight sale or new categories within the slider
- Include optional CTA buttons for directing users to category overviews

## Design Rationale

The slider automatically adapts its navigation visibility based on content: when all nodes fit on screen, navigation controls hide to reduce visual clutter. The two-row option on mobile collapses to a single row on larger breakpoints to optimize space usage. Navigation position flexibility (top or bottom) allows integration with various page layouts and header configurations.
shortDescription: Commonly used under listing page titles for subcategory display. Uses LuiCommonSwiper, LuiSwiperNavigationCompact, and LuiSwipperScrollbar for slider functionality. CTA button automatically positions navigation to bottom. Multiple color modes support light, dark, and bright backgrounds with optional header and subline text.
